reviews.text: Caring doctors.
We've only been going to them since we moved to the district two years ago. Doctors Zsolt and Dávid Hámori are very good doctors.

Doctor David is perhaps the most patient, kindest, and most honest veterinarian I have ever met. I brought my 13-year-old cat to him for a check-up, and he is not an easy case to examine, to say the least. Doctor David did not give up and despite all the difficulties, he thoroughly examined the cat. I am very grateful to him and I recommend him wholeheartedly.

The young doctor is a complete joke. I asked for deworming for my two cats, but he was only willing to give it to one of them, because the other one might not have worms. I understand that it is customary to deworm a cat just to be on the safe side, especially if one of them is definitely wormed and there are small children at home. He knew better, we didn't just get one dose of medicine. Let's go back, if the other one is definitely wormed too... This is not the first smart, arrogant, bad experience I have had with him. He didn't even refuse to give me the walk-in vaccination, because he didn't think it was necessary... I gave it to him somewhere else. I won't be coming here from now on, but unfortunately this one is close by.
We have been coming here for 16 years. We have always received excellent care at an affordable price.
An experienced, excellent doctor.

My puppy received a thorough examination and thorough care. They really love animals here and are kind to their owners.
All kinds of diagnostic tests were also performed on site.
..and last but not least, all this at a very friendly price.
I recommend it wholeheartedly!
Very experienced - with very kind doctors

We have taken our chaotic dog here many times and have had only good experiences.
- reliable
- they love animals
- cheap
It's a shame we had to put our dog down there.
I highly recommend them to everyone!
For decades, all of our dogs and cats have been treated by Dr. Hámori, very conscientiously, in a reassuring manner, and with immense knowledge. We are very grateful to him!
I regularly go there with my English Bulldog for general care, the doctors are very kind, flexible, and skilled. I would gladly bring my dog ​​here. :)
Very conscientious doctor, I recommend him to everyone
thank you so much
On behalf of my cat KEŞKÜL and I, we would like to thank our vet friend for his help. I was shocked to read the negative reviews – these people are fantastic. Thanks again for everything!
They are extremely helpful, compassionate, animal-loving, and highly skilled.

We took our poor little dog here for surgery in January…. He had “surgery” at around 7am.. he died that evening around 10pm.
We called in the afternoon that the dog was in a lot of pain, he could barely breathe. We would have taken him in right away, money wouldn’t have mattered, but he attributed it to “shock from the surgery”. “He’ll calm down.” Unfortunately, he calmed down forever.
As it turned out, it was edema, not shock.

Back in 2024, I rescued a cat from the street who, as it turned out, was not neutered, and gave birth to 4 kittens. They were healthy, but one of the kittens dragged its two hind legs behind it, this vet was the closest so I ran down very quickly with the kitten.
The vet said this
"She's paralyzed, let's put her to sleep because she's just suffering"
"IT'S UNSAVABLE, IT'S NOT A CAT"
I didn't need to ask what I owed her (fortunately nothing) and went home with the kitten.
I made a brace for her leg out of a toilet paper roll and made sure she didn't drag her leg, then a little later I turned on the tap and put water in it so she could use her leg, of course I held it so she wouldn't drown. I repeated this every day and not long after, her leg was completely healed.

I don't even understand how someone who burps at an owner like "THIS IS NOT A CAT" can call themselves a veterinarian.

After a year, I can slowly say that this little fairy couldn't be more of a cat.
I didn't give up on her.
Very professional, patient. I definitely recommend him!
Dr. Hámori is a great, knowledgeable, extremely helpful, and caring doctor.

For decades, we have been able to trust our animals – our family members – with peace of mind in the caring hands of Dr. Hámori, thanks to his excellent expertise. Dávid is also a great veterinarian, who is truly outstanding with his professional and empathetic attitude. Friendly prices, fair attitude – I recommend him wholeheartedly!
Super helpful and friendly! Even without appointment they try to take your pet asap. Small practice but big expertise and service! 🧡 …

The veterinarian is not God, but a true HUMAN with a capital letter - or when the veterinary textbook opens
I have been preparing to write this post for a month, but no matter how many times I tried, those certain terrible tears wouldn't let me.
I will tell you:
A book on the table...a veterinary textbook...a gust of wind blows, the pages of the book start spinning and the book opens at a chapter...which comes to life.
A one and a half year old puppy on the examination table...On this day, there and then, the page of the textbook comes to life, the page that is theory, the page that is every owner's and doctor's nightmare, the page that even experienced doctors have never seen described in such a young dog. Still....There was a task to be solved, where there is only hope and faith and trying. Life intended this path for us, we had to step on it, because the pet comes first and its interests must always be looked at. We set out on this journey, where two wonderful people with a heart and soul were our traveling companions: Dr. Zsolt Hámori and Dr. Justin Dávid. On this journey, small successes are experienced followed by endless ups and downs. We set out with hope and as time passed, it became increasingly obvious that there was a possibility. To the best of our knowledge, to walk this journey with dignity hidden in love, to see when the time had come and to accept that although we hoped to win the battle, both the doctor and the owner did everything for this....we still lost it, because although miracles exist (since two of our doctors cured our then 14-year-old puppy, who was paralyzed in both legs, with the right procedure two years ago, who is now 16+ and still happily runs around the Vérmező), they do not always show themselves, and sometimes you have to bow your head to fate with acceptance and surrender.
For a month, they were by our side from the beginning to the end, holding our hands, trying everything and even the impossible in a superhuman way to help the puppy. We were daily guests at the clinic and in addition to treating the puppy, they answered our endless questions, listened to our fears and doubts, supported us spiritually, and kept us strong. A doctor and a person cannot do more than that.
Yes...we all sat with helpless anger and despair, eyes bleary, asking ourselves and each other the question WHY and WHERE TO GO NEXT.
A flood of SMS messages at any time of the day, sometimes even on weekends, to which the answer always came.
They were by our side at the specialist clinic. They explained clearly what was on the chart, where we could go next.
Then suddenly the circle closed... and there was no more. The voice on the phone dies away...doc come...puppy asking for help, he's standing here at the foot of the rainbow bridge....Yes, the doc came...giving up, postponing his evening program after work hours...he came, he was by our side. The journey ended, we stood at the foot of the rainbow bridge, watching the puppy run across with his baggy ears flapping, looking back from the other side, he shouted back, waving - "We didn't part, I just ran forward..."....At that moment, a light breeze closed the veterinary book on the table....
After all this, I think that the Hungarian language has little vocabulary with which I could express what I feel. That's why I can only say THANK YOU SO MUCH
I am grateful to our doctors for being our companions on this bumpy road...we couldn't have wished for better people.
For us, YOU are the best, both professionally and personally!
The place is good, the doctor's office is clean and tidy, the doctor and the assistant lady are very nice, the doctor is very good at what he does, so I can recommend them with a clear heart 🙂 …
We have been taking our cat to Dr. Hámori for years because we know him to be an excellent doctor!!!

Dr. David is wonderful. It's so nice to see someone so dedicated to their work and so passionate about animals. The prices are great, and he explains everything very thoroughly and is very understanding of your concerns about your pet.
